mentions.name: WorkBill
mentions.description: This app is a modern QuickBooks alternative built on beancount that exposes the double-entry ledger model directly, enabling customers to model complex transactions even when there is no direct support for them. It has been in development for a month and is built with Elixir, Phoenix, InertiaJS, and React. A demo is available at https://demo.workbill.co.
mentions.problem: Traditional accounting platforms do not expose the ledger model, making it hard to model complex transactions when direct support is lacking.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A modern QuickBooks, based on beancount, WorkBill (https://workbill.co). You can play with it at https://demo.workbill.co.

Unlike traditional accounting platforms we expose the ledger model directly which enables our customers to model complex transactions even when we do not have direct support for it.
